description: Upgrade to Solana SDK 3.0, then build comprehensive test suite with LiteSVM + Mollusk and 30+ example programs derived from idiomatic Anchor programs

userStories.title: Upgrade solana-sdk to 3.0

acceptanceCriteria: Update solana-sdk version to 3.0.x in Cargo.toml
Fix any breaking API changes in Seahorse compiler code
cargo build succeeds with new SDK version
userStories.notes: Upgraded to solana-sdk 2.2.1 and mollusk-svm 0.1.3 - the latest versions compatible with Anchor 0.32.x. True SDK 3.0 (modular crates) requires Anchor 1.0+ which is not yet stable.

userStories.notes: Anchor 0.32.1 with Solana SDK 2.2.x modular crates. Removed outdated ahash pin, updated pyth-sdk-solana to 0.10.6. Generated Cargo.toml inherits anchor-lang version from anchor init.

userStories.title: Set up LiteSVM Rust test harness

Implement test utilities for account creation and PDA derivation

userStories.notes: Completed as part of US-003. Uses litesvm 0.6.1 with solana modular crates 2.2.x. Helpers include litesvm_with_program for loading .so files, anchor_instruction for building instructions, and execute_tx for running transactions. 15 integration tests pass.

userStories.notes: Created tests/ts/ with litesvm 0.4.0, @coral-xyz/anchor 0.32.0, anchor-litesvm 0.2.1, and vitest 2.1.x. Helpers match Rust: liteSvmWithProgram, fundedKeypair, anchorInstruction, executeTx, discriminator functions, PDA derivation, slot warping. 18 TypeScript tests pass.

userStories.title: Create test program compilation pipeline
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an automated pipeline that compiles Seahorse examples and reference Anchor programs for testing.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/build-test-programs.sh to compile all programs
Script compiles Seahorse examples to Rust via seahorse compile
Script builds compiled programs to .so files via anchor build
Script builds reference Anchor programs to .so files
userStories.notes: Created scripts/build-test-programs.sh that compiles 7 Seahorse examples to Rust and builds them to .so files. 6 programs build successfully - stored_mutables fails due to pre-existing Seahorse compiler issue with Data type. Outputs stored in target/deploy/.

userStories.title: Implement behavior comparison framework
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a framework to compare state changes between Seahorse and Anchor program executions.
acceptanceCriteria: Helper to execute same instruction on both Seahorse and Anchor versions
Account state diffing: compare account data after execution
Clear error messages when behavior diverges
Support for comparing multiple instructions in sequence
userStories.notes: Created tests/common/ crate with CompareContext, InstructionBuilder, account diffing, and colored report output. All 25 unit tests pass. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Counter program

userStories.notes: Reference at tests/anchor-reference/counter_anchor/. Seahorse at examples/counter.py. 11 Mollusk unit tests, 10 LiteSVM integration tests, 2 parity tests. Note: Seahorse requires rent sysvar for init, Anchor doesn't - parity tests account for this difference.

userStories.notes: Reference at tests/anchor-reference/calculator_anchor/. 14 Mollusk unit tests covering ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV operations and edge cases. 12 LiteSVM integration tests for full workflow. 3 parity tests. Unauthorized access tests verify owner validation. Division by zero panics correctly.

userStories.title: PDA derivation patterns
userStories.description: As a user, I want examples demonstrating various PDA derivation patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Patterns: single seed, multiple seeds, user-derived PDAs, bump handling
Tests verify correct PDA addresses are derived
Tests verify bump seeds are stored/used correctly
userStories.notes: Seahorse at examples/pda_patterns.py. Reference at tests/anchor-reference/pda_patterns_anchor/. 14 LiteSVM integration tests, 4 parity tests. Patterns: global_config (single seed), user_profile (user-derived), data_record (category+id), vault (owner+id). Bump stored and verified. Note: Anchor requires vault_id in deposit_to_vault instruction data for PDA verification.

userStories.title: Account initialization patterns
userStories.description: As a user, I want examples of different account initialization approaches.
userStories.notes: Seahorse at examples/init_patterns.py. Reference at tests/anchor-reference/init_patterns_anchor/. Demonstrates SimpleData (primitives: u8, u16, u32, u64, i64), StringData (strings with padding), ArrayData (fixed-size arrays), ComplexData (nested struct Stats). Note: Seahorse doesn't support init_if_needed - only Empty[T].init(). Space calculation via padding parameter for variable-length data. 17 LiteSVM integration tests, 4 parity tests. All tests verify rent exemption and space calculation.
